name: Amaterasu
summary: A dark cinematic AI style with a full-bleed teal-lit hero, polar-white text, cosmic-violet outlined controls, whisper-light display typography, wide-tracked uppercase labels, and no shadows.

cosmicViolet.role: Primary brand ink, outlined button borders, heading text on light surfaces

twilightIndigo.role: Secondary violet borders and gradient origins

auroraTeal.role: Atmospheric teal pulled from hero photography

cyanGlow.role: Directional teal light for atmospheric panels

polarWhite.role: Primary text on dark surfaces and light panel surface

obsidian.role: Deepest contrast and text on light surfaces

silverSlate.role: Subtle decorative lines and secondary UI elements

ceruleanMist.role: Decorative SVG stroke and illustration accents

stormShadow.role: Muted focus-ring shadows and hover glows

components.hero: Full-bleed teal-lit dark portrait with white whisper display text.
components.outlinedPrimaryAction: Transparent pill CTA with #1b2978 border and text.
components.labelNav: NeoSans-style uppercase micro labels with extreme tracking.
components.atmosphericPanel: Dark or light panel using cyan glow or violet wash gradients.
components.lineIcon: Thin decorative SVG stroke in cerulean or silver slate.
components.lightSection: Polar-white surface with cosmic-violet heading ink and obsidian text.

dos: Use #1b2978 as the only structural UI ink.
Keep display type light and tightly tracked.
Use outlined pill actions instead of filled buttons.
donts: Do not use teal as a CTA or text color.
Do not add heavy filled CTAs.
Do not add card shadows or modal glows.
Do not use bold hero type.
Do not build a busy dashboard layout.
